collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official OpenCode Go docs page and landing page (English) around 10:37 Beijing time / 02:37Z on 2026-11-05, compared against the 2026-11-04 capture of the same pages. The official per-model pricing tables (Go / Go Plus / Go Teams), the per-model Monthly limit column, the usage-window rule, the official 'Estimated requests' tables, the landing-page Go model table and the privacy table were read as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: OpenCode Go official price table only. One catalog entry was added on 2026-11-05: the new paid model 'Hy4' (model id hy4). The landing-page banner changed from 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash gets 4× usage limits for a limited time' to 'Hy4 is now available in Go', the allowance counter moved from 'Allowances for eleven Go models' to 'Allowances for twelve Go models', and the model counter moved from 'View all 30 models' to 'View all 31 models'. The existing 'Hy4 preview' row (model id hy4-preview) stays in the table with unchanged prices and limits. No leaderboard/score data, no Command Code GOAT change (cross-channel note only), no shared-pool figure restated, no adopted.csv row, no computed allowance in this file.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; no opencode_go × hy4 row in adopted.csv yet — adding one requires an OPENCODE_GO_MODELS entry in scripts/build_adopted.py, left to maintainer review
